title: QuickSight SPICE Capacity Utilization
dataSources: MicroStrategy DSSErrors/statistics, Cognos audit database via DB Connect, BusinessObjects Auditing/CMS logs, Oracle Analytics usage tracking, ThoughtSpot audit logs, QuickSight CloudTrail and SPICE CloudWatch metrics.
app: MicroStrategy / IBM Cognos / SAP BusinessObjects / Oracle Analytics / ThoughtSpot / Amazon QuickSight logs via Universal Forwarder, vendor admin APIs, and cloud provider TAs (`Splunk_TA_aws` for QuickSight).
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=aws:cloudwatch namespace="AWS/QuickSight" metric_name=SPICECapacityConsumedInBytes
| stats latest(Maximum) as used_bytes by account_id, region
| eval used_gb=round(used_bytes/1024/1024/1024,1)
| where used_gb>0
| sort - used_gb
description: Tracks Amazon QuickSight SPICE in-memory capacity consumption so teams can top up before ingestion and refresh fail on a full engine.
value: A full SPICE engine blocks dataset refreshes and new imports; capacity visibility prevents an avoidable outage and controls spend.
implementation: Ingest QuickSight CloudWatch metrics via `Splunk_TA_aws`; schedule hourly; alert near the limit.
visualization: Single-value SPICE usage, capacity trend, alert.
grandmaExplanation: We watch how full the QuickSight memory engine is so it does not fill up and stop new data from loading.
